label: ILLUSTRATIVE isotopic cross-section set for the convection-decay closed forms of theory:cr-secondary-ratio: round placeholder values, not taken from any measurement or parametrization
energy_dependence: none (energy-independent placeholders; real cross sections vary with energy)
meaning: production_mb: effective cumulative production cross section of each propagated isotope from each parent (short-lived ghost nuclei assumed included; 10Be is propagated explicitly, so its decay is not in the 10B value); inelastic_mb: total inelastic (destruction) cross section of each species
